name: Yukimi Shigure
source:
Shigure is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of [url=/c39591]Guren's[/url] squad in the Moon Demon Company. Like [url=/c39567]Sayuri[/url], she is also a servant for the Ichinose Family. Shigure appears to be quiet but occasionally has some funny responses. She is the quietest member of Guren's squad. Her personality is calm and she tends to hide her emotions.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Shigure_Yukimi]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
